name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Top-level adaptive aero control shell. Integrates firmware-visible CSR/MMIO, request transport, response validation, timeout/stale detection, bounded actuator command generation, and safe fallback behavior. It is the required top module and is fully synthesizable RTL.
functionality: Implements the digital control shell around a remote surrogate execution service. The module accepts packed 128-bit requests only when valid/ready handshakes complete, captures sequence/mode/reference/velocity summary/config tags, emits request context to the host side, accepts 128-bit responses from the host side, validates echoed sequence, freshness, and age, rejects stale or mismatched responses, latches timeout/fault conditions, and produces a bounded 64-bit actuator command or a safe fallback command. The module also exposes a small firmware-visible register window for mode control, sequence tracking, timeout/stale limits, actuator bounds, fallback selection, and fault clear semantics.
responsibilities: Accept and backpressure model requests until downstream acceptance conditions allow a new outstanding request.
Expose a 128-bit request record on s_req_data with valid/ready semantics to the remote software surrogate runner.
Accept a 128-bit response record on s_rsp_data with valid/ready semantics and validate sequence/freshness/age before use.
Generate a 64-bit actuator command word only from validated response data or from safe fallback manager state.
Clamp actuator target fields to programmable min/max bounds before issuing the command.
Assert safe fallback on reset, timeout expiry, stale response detection, invalid response status, or host fault conditions.
Provide firmware-visible CSR/MMIO access to operating mode, timeout limit, stale-age limit, actuator bounds, fallback selector, request sequence, status, and fault clear controls.
Use technology-neutral block RAM style storage for request/response history or buffering when needed for timing closure.
Keep all outputs registered and deterministic, with no combinational loops across ready/valid or control paths.
reset_behavior: On rst_n deassertion, clear outstanding request state, clear validated-response state, clear timeout and stale counters, assert safe fallback, set command outputs to the predefined safe aerodynamic configuration, deassert command valid until a fresh valid response is accepted, and initialize MMIO status readback to faultless safe mode with explicit reset state fields as defined by the register contract.
behavior_rules: s_req_valid and s_req_data are only captured when s_req_ready is asserted in the same cycle.
At most one outstanding request is tracked for command generation unless internal buffering is explicitly enabled by firmware.
s_rsp_valid and s_rsp_data are only accepted when s_rsp_ready is asserted and the echoed sequence matches the tracked request sequence.
Responses with invalid status, stale age, or timeout expiry are rejected and must not update the actuator command.
The command manager clamps every actuator target field to the programmed min/max range before issuing m_cmd_data.

Safe fallback remains active whenever reset is asserted, a timeout occurs, a stale response is detected, the response is invalid, or a host fault is asserted, and is released only after a fresh validated response is accepted.
Firmware may clear latched faults through the documented MMIO control path, but clearing does not bypass validation or timeout checks.
Response freshness and watchdog expiry are independently evaluated to prevent stale commands from driving actuators.
No top-level output may be left undriven; all status and transport outputs must have real RTL drivers.
The design must not expose large model artifacts or internal arrays at the top level.

register_contract.transaction_semantics: mmio_valid indicates a transaction request; mmio_write selects write transactions; mmio_ready returns response/acceptance; mmio_rdata is valid on read completion or read-side return cycle as implemented by the RTL.

fields.name: fallback_sel
fields.description: Selects predefined safe aerodynamic fallback configuration.

fields.name: act_min
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator targets.

fields.name: act_max
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator targets.
